incident.title: Elevated error rates on the Responses API

updates.body: We are seeing elevated 5xx errors on the Responses API for some models and are investigating.
We have identified a capacity shortfall in one inference cluster and are shifting traffic away from it.
Error rates are back to normal. Some requests may still see higher latency while the cluster recovers.
Latency is back to normal. This incident is resolved.

incident.title: Sign-in failures for some accounts
incident.markdown:
## Impact

For 66 minutes, about 30% of sign-in attempts failed with an error page. People already signed in were not affected, and API requests authenticated with keys kept working.

## Timeline

1. 09:12 UTC — a session-store change is deployed
2. 09:15 UTC — sign-in error rate alert fires
3. 09:41 UTC — the change is identified and rolled back
4. 10:18 UTC — error rate back to baseline

## What caused it

The change shortened a connection timeout to the session store. Under morning load, a share of sign-ins timed out before the store answered.

## What we changed

Timeout changes now ship behind a flag and roll out to 1% of traffic first, with automatic rollback on a rise in sign-in errors.

updates.body: Some people cannot sign in and see an error page. We are investigating.
We have identified a recent change as the cause and are rolling it back.
The rollback is complete. Sign-ins are recovering.
Sign-in is working normally. We have published a write-up.

incident.title: Batch queue migration
incident.markdown: We are moving the Batch queue to new storage. New batches submitted during the window start after it ends; batches already running are not interrupted.
